title: Within-line word-edge dependence is stronger than across selected line boundaries in Currier B
statement: For certain paragraph-text tokens on Currier B pages, the project’s bias-corrected mutual information between the last EVA-basic glyph of one word and the first glyph of the next is at least 0.08 bits higher within lines than at transitions between successive selected paragraph lines on the same page with certain endpoints. The one-sided within-page word permutation test has p at most 0.01 over 199 shuffles. The claim concerns Currier B and the fixed selection and null.
source: Whole-manuscript F-010 (https://voynichswarm.com/x/F-010.html), and the Currier A specification in F-025 (https://voynichswarm.com/x/F-025.html). The statistic, select filter, numerical threshold and shuffle are unchanged; the scope is Currier B.
